recommended_paths: Accept the local cutover architecture as ready for controlled external validation, while keeping the TODO active and making no completion or production claim. Perform the redacted real-provider protocol for Meta authorization/selected-number/receipt and device QR/own-number proof, then demonstrate real IN and OUT for both modalities and complete the remaining required consolidation gates. findings.title: Required real-provider and device evidence is still absent for overall TODO closure
findings.rationale: The bounded evidence proves local configuration, synthetic callback/header behavior, isolated runtime wiring, and local test behavior, but not an actual Meta Embedded Signup authorization and selected-number lifecycle, actual device QR pairing with own-number confirmation, or real inbound and outbound delivery for both modalities. The governing TODO explicitly remains Pending and requires real proofs; provider doubles and synthetic probes cannot substitute for them. This blocks overall closeout, not the local canonical-cutover conclusion.
findings.suggested_action: Keep the TODO active; use authorized test resources and the temporary HTTPS origin to capture redacted, per-channel evidence for authorization/pairing, identity confirmation, first IN, and OUT receipt. Then submit those results to the remaining required closeout and consolidation gates.
